discussion.name: gitlab_list_discussions
discussion.method: ListForIssueAsync / ListForMergeRequestAsync / ListForCommitAsync / ListForSnippetAsync / ListForEpicAsync (dispatched by noteable_type)
discussion.purpose: List the threaded, resolvable discussion threads on an issue, MR, commit, snippet or epic (each entry includes its notes), bounded by limit.

discussion.name: gitlab_list_notes
discussion.method: ListIssueNotesAsync / ListMergeRequestNotesAsync / ListSnippetNotesAsync / ListVulnerabilityNotesAsync / ListProjectWikiPageNotesAsync / ListEpicNotesAsync / ListGroupWikiPageNotesAsync (dispatched by noteable_type)
discussion.purpose: List the flat comments/system-notes on an issue, merge request, snippet, vulnerability, wiki page or epic, bounded by limit.

discussion.name: gitlab_list_draft_notes
discussion.purpose: List the caller's own pending, unpublished review comments on a merge request.

discussion.name: gitlab_list_reactions
discussion.method: ListForIssueAsync / ListForIssueNoteAsync / ListForMergeRequestAsync / ListForMergeRequestNoteAsync / ListForSnippetAsync / ListForSnippetNoteAsync / ListForEpicAsync / ListForEpicNoteAsync (dispatched by target_type)
discussion.purpose: List the emoji reactions on an issue, MR, snippet, epic, or a note on any of them.

discussion.name: gitlab_render_markdown
discussion.purpose: Preview how GitLab Flavored Markdown (or plain CommonMark) will render to HTML, optionally resolving #/!/@/~ references against a project.

discussion.name: gitlab_list_events
discussion.method: ListAsync / ListForProjectAsync / ListForUserAsync (dispatched by scope: me/project/user)
discussion.purpose: List recent activity-feed events for the caller, a project, or a user (not an audit log - excludes epic/MR events and is retention-limited).

discussion.name: gitlab_get_discussion
discussion.method: GetForIssueAsync / GetForMergeRequestAsync / GetForCommitAsync / GetForSnippetAsync / GetForEpicAsync (dispatched by noteable_type)
discussion.purpose: Read one discussion thread and every note inside it in one call.

discussion.name: gitlab_create_discussion
discussion.method: CreateForIssueAsync / CreateForMergeRequestAsync / CreateForCommitAsync / CreateForSnippetAsync / CreateForEpicAsync (dispatched by noteable_type)
discussion.purpose: Start a new resolvable discussion thread; on merge_request/commit, optionally anchor it to a diff line as a review comment.

discussion.name: gitlab_create_draft_note
discussion.purpose: Stage a review comment on a merge request without publishing it yet, optionally as a reply or resolving a discussion on publish.

discussion.name: gitlab_update_note
discussion.method: UpdateIssueNoteAsync / UpdateMergeRequestNoteAsync / UpdateSnippetNoteAsync / UpdateVulnerabilityNoteAsync / UpdateProjectWikiPageNoteAsync / UpdateEpicNoteAsync / UpdateGroupWikiPageNoteAsync (dispatched by noteable_type)
discussion.purpose: Replace the body of an existing note the caller authored (or has maintainer rights over).

discussion.name: gitlab_add_reaction
discussion.method: AddToIssueAsync / AddToIssueNoteAsync / AddToMergeRequestAsync / AddToMergeRequestNoteAsync / AddToSnippetAsync / AddToSnippetNoteAsync / AddToEpicAsync / AddToEpicNoteAsync (dispatched by target_type)
discussion.purpose: React with an emoji (name without colons) to an issue/MR/snippet/epic or a note on one.

discussion.name: gitlab_apply_suggestion
discussion.purpose: Apply one code suggestion from a review comment, committing it to the merge request's source branch. Caller must already have the suggestion id (not discoverable via this library's note model).

mergerequests.name: gitlab_list_group_merge_requests
mergerequests.purpose: List merge requests across a group and all of its subgroups for a cross-project view.

mergerequests.name: gitlab_get_approval_settings
mergerequests.purpose: Read the approval policy switches for a project or group -- author self-approval, committer approval, reset-approvals-on-push, and similar governance flags.

mergerequests.name: gitlab_list_approval_rules
mergerequests.purpose: List the standing approval rules configured on a project or group, to see what approvals a merge request will need before it can merge.

mergerequests.name: gitlab_list_merge_train
mergerequests.purpose: List the merge requests currently queued on a project's merge train(s), optionally filtered to one target branch.

mergerequests.name: gitlab_list_external_status_checks
mergerequests.purpose: List the external status checks configured on a project, or (given a merge_request_iid) the live results of those checks against one merge request.

mergerequests.name: gitlab_list_merge_request_commits
mergerequests.purpose: List the commits that make up a merge request.

mergerequests.name: gitlab_get_merge_request_approvals
mergerequests.purpose: Check whether a merge request is approved, by whom, and which approval rules remain outstanding -- combines the approvers view (GetApprovalsAsync) and the rule-by-rule view (GetApprovalStateAsync) in one call.

mergerequests.name: gitlab_list_merge_request_pipelines
mergerequests.purpose: List CI pipelines that have run for a merge request, to check merge-gate status before merging.

mergerequests.name: gitlab_list_merge_request_related_issues
mergerequests.purpose: List the issues a merge request will close on merge, or (via a relation switch) every issue it references, for traceability between planning and code.

mergerequests.name: gitlab_list_merge_request_reviewers
mergerequests.purpose: List a merge request's reviewers and each one's review state (unreviewed, reviewed, requested changes).

mergerequests.name: gitlab_list_merge_requests
mergerequests.purpose: List a project's merge requests filtered by state/labels/branch/author/search, bounded by limit, for triage and status overview.

mergerequests.name: gitlab_create_merge_request
mergerequests.purpose: Open a new merge request from a source branch to a target branch with a title/description.

mergerequests.name: gitlab_create_approval_rule
mergerequests.purpose: Create a standing approval rule on a project or group with named approvers/groups and a required approval count.

mergerequests.name: gitlab_approve_merge_request
mergerequests.purpose: Approve a merge request as the authenticated user.

mergerequests.name: gitlab_add_to_merge_train
mergerequests.purpose: Queue a merge request onto its target branch's merge train.

mergerequests.name: gitlab_update_merge_request
mergerequests.purpose: Edit a merge request's title, description, labels, assignees, reviewers or milestone, or close/reopen it via the state event.

mergerequests.name: gitlab_update_approval_rule
mergerequests.purpose: Update a standing approval rule's approvers or required count; approver lists sent are authoritative and replace the existing list.

mergerequests.name: gitlab_unapprove_merge_request
mergerequests.purpose: Withdraw the authenticated user's own approval from a merge request.

planning.name: gitlab_list_issue_links
planning.purpose: List the issues linked to this one (relates_to / blocks / is_blocked_by), each carrying its link id and link type.

planning.name: gitlab_list_milestone_burndown_events
planning.purpose: List the burndown chart events of a milestone. Premium/Ultimate feature; expect a 403 on lower plans.

planning.name: gitlab_list_board_lists
planning.purpose: List a board's lists (columns) in board order.

planning.name: gitlab_list_labels
planning.purpose: List a project's or group's labels, optionally with issue/MR counts.

planning.name: gitlab_list_resource_groups
planning.purpose: List the CI/CD resource groups (deployment-concurrency mutexes) a project's pipelines have created.

planning.name: gitlab_list_iterations
planning.purpose: List the iterations visible to a group or project. Read-only: iterations are scheduled through cadences the REST API doesn't expose here; a project's iterations actually come from its ancestor groups.

planning.name: gitlab_list_todos
planning.purpose: List the authenticated user's to-do items, filterable by action, author, project, group, state, or type. Pending items only with no filters.

planning.name: gitlab_list_resource_events
planning.method: ListIssueLabelEventsAsync, ListIssueStateEventsAsync, ListIssueMilestoneEventsAsync, ListIssueIterationEventsAsync, ListIssueWeightEventsAsync, ListMergeRequestLabelEventsAsync, ListMergeRequestStateEventsAsync, ListMergeRequestMilestoneEventsAsync, ListEpicLabelEventsAsync, ListEpicStateEventsAsync
planning.purpose: List the machine-readable change history (label, state, milestone, iteration, or weight events) of an issue, merge request, or epic. Not every family exists for every eventable type: issues have all five, merge requests have label/state/milestone only, epics have label/state only.

planning.name: gitlab_list_issue_participants
planning.purpose: List the users participating in an issue's discussion.

planning.name: gitlab_list_milestone_issues
planning.purpose: List every issue assigned to a milestone.

planning.name: gitlab_list_boards
planning.purpose: List a project's or group's issue boards.

planning.name: gitlab_get_label
planning.purpose: Get one label by name (or numeric id) at project or group scope.

planning.name: gitlab_create_issue
planning.purpose: Create a new issue with title, description, labels, assignees, milestone, due/start date, weight, confidentiality and type.

planning.name: gitlab_create_board
planning.purpose: Create a new issue board.

planning.name: gitlab_create_milestone
planning.purpose: Create a milestone with a title, description, and start/due dates at project or group scope.

planning.name: gitlab_create_label
planning.purpose: Create a label with a name and color (and, at project scope, a priority) at project or group scope.

planning.name: gitlab_create_todo
planning.purpose: Create a to-do item for yourself on an issue or merge request.

planning.name: gitlab_set_issue_subscription
planning.purpose: Subscribe or unsubscribe the authenticated user to an issue's notifications.

planning.name: gitlab_set_resource_group_process_mode
planning.purpose: Change the order in which a resource group releases queued jobs (e.g. unordered / oldest_first / newest_first).

planning.name: gitlab_update_issue
planning.purpose: Apply a partial update to an issue's fields (title, description, labels, assignees, milestone, weight, severity, confidentiality, dates) without touching its open/closed state.

code.name: gitlab_list_commit_comments
code.purpose: Read line- or commit-level comments left on a commit.

code.name: gitlab_list_repository_contributors
code.purpose: Per-author commit and line-change counts, for activity or ownership questions.

code.name: gitlab_get_file_blame
code.purpose: Find which commit and author last touched each line of a file, optionally scoped to a line range.

code.name: gitlab_list_branches
code.purpose: List a project's branches, optionally filtered by name or regex.

code.name: gitlab_list_commit_statuses
code.purpose: See what external CI systems have reported for a commit.

code.name: gitlab_list_protected_branches
code.purpose: See which branches or wildcard patterns are protected and who may push, merge or unprotect them.

code.name: gitlab_list_protected_tags
code.purpose: See which tags or wildcard patterns are protected and who may create matching tags.

code.name: gitlab_get_push_rule
code.purpose: Read a project's push rule — commit-message/branch-name regexes, secret detection, signing requirements.

code.name: gitlab_get_pull_mirror
code.purpose: Check a project's pull-mirror configuration and last sync status.

code.name: gitlab_create_commit
code.purpose: Commit several file create/update/delete/move/chmod actions atomically in one push, without a local git checkout.

code.name: gitlab_create_file
code.purpose: Create a new file and commit it directly to a branch, no local checkout needed.

code.name: gitlab_create_branch
code.purpose: Create a branch from a ref (branch, tag or commit SHA).

code.name: gitlab_create_tag
code.purpose: Tag a ref, optionally as an annotated tag carrying a release message.

code.name: gitlab_protect_branch
code.purpose: Protect a branch or wildcard pattern with role-, user- or group-grained push/merge/unprotect rules.

code.name: gitlab_protect_tag
code.purpose: Protect a tag or wildcard pattern so only specific roles may create matching tags.

people.name: gitlab_list_enterprise_users
people.purpose: List, or get one by id, the SAML/SCIM-provisioned enterprise users claimed by a group.

people.name: gitlab_list_impersonation_tokens
people.purpose: List, or get one by id, a user's impersonation tokens.

people.name: gitlab_list_members
people.purpose: List a project's or group's members, direct or including inherited/invited-group memberships, bounded by limit.

people.name: gitlab_list_ssh_keys
people.purpose: List the caller's SSH keys, or another user's (served without authentication by GitLab).

people.name: gitlab_list_resource_access_tokens
people.purpose: List a project's or group's access tokens (bot-account tokens scoped to that resource).

people.name: gitlab_list_service_accounts
people.purpose: List service accounts at instance, group, or project scope.

people.name: gitlab_list_member_roles
people.purpose: List custom member roles at instance, group, or instance-admin-role scope.

people.name: gitlab_list_access_requests
people.purpose: List pending access requests on a project or group.

people.name: gitlab_update_group_member_state
people.purpose: Move a user's group membership between Awaiting and Active state to free or reclaim a paid seat.

people.name: gitlab_create_impersonation_token
people.purpose: Create a token that acts as another user for both API calls and Git — the most privileged credential this server can mint; the plaintext secret is shown only once.

people.name: gitlab_create_current_user_runner
people.purpose: Register a new CI/CD runner owned by the caller; the returned registration token is shown once and must be persisted immediately.

people.name: gitlab_update_enterprise_user
people.purpose: Update an enterprise user's name, email or project limit, or disable their two-factor authentication.

people.name: gitlab_create_invitation
people.purpose: Invite one or more people, by email or user id, to a project or group at a given access level.

people.name: gitlab_create_resource_access_token
people.purpose: Create a project or group access token with chosen scopes and access level; the plaintext token is returned only once.

projects.name: gitlab_list_group_issues
projects.purpose: List issues across a group and its subgroups, filtered by state, labels, assignee, milestone, iteration, weight, etc.

projects.name: gitlab_list_namespace_storage_limit_exclusions
projects.purpose: List every namespace instance-wide that's excluded from storage-limit enforcement.

projects.name: gitlab_list_project_uploads
projects.purpose: List markdown-attachment uploads on a project (requires Maintainer or Owner role).

projects.name: gitlab_list_project_aliases
projects.purpose: List every Git-level project alias on the instance (Premium/Ultimate, administrators only).

projects.name: gitlab_list_topics
projects.purpose: List instance-wide project topics, sorted by how many projects carry each one.

projects.name: gitlab_list_badges
projects.purpose: List a project's or group's badges, including group-inherited ones on a project (wraps ListForGroupAsync).

projects.name: gitlab_list_custom_attributes
projects.purpose: List custom key/value attributes on a user, group, or project, selected by entity_type (wraps ListForUserAsync/ListForGroupAsync); administrator-only, reads included.

projects.name: gitlab_get_avatar_url_for_email
projects.purpose: Resolve the avatar image URL GitLab would serve for a public email address; always answers 200, so this is not proof the account exists.

projects.name: gitlab_list_storage_moves
projects.purpose: List Gitaly repository-storage moves for a project, group, or snippet, or instance-wide when no entity id is given (wraps ListAllProjectMovesAsync/ListForGroupAsync/ListForSnippetAsync and group/snippet equivalents); self-managed instances only.

projects.name: gitlab_list_group_projects
projects.purpose: List projects a group owns, or projects shared into it, selected by a shared:bool (wraps ListSharedProjectsAsync).

projects.name: gitlab_create_ci_config_merge_request
projects.purpose: Open a merge request that adds a starter .gitlab-ci.yml to a project with none.

projects.name: gitlab_create_group
projects.purpose: Create a top-level group, or a subgroup when a parent group is given.

projects.name: gitlab_delete_topic
projects.purpose: Delete a topic; projects that carried it simply lose the label.

projects.name: gitlab_create_badge
projects.purpose: Add a badge to a project or group (wraps CreateForGroupAsync); group badges are inherited by every project under it.

projects.name: gitlab_delete_project_upload
projects.purpose: Delete a project upload by numeric id or by secret+filename (wraps DeleteBySecretAsync).

projects.name: gitlab_create_project_alias
projects.purpose: Create an alias so an imported project keeps answering to its old Git name.

projects.name: gitlab_set_custom_attribute
projects.purpose: Create or overwrite a custom attribute on a user, group, or project (wraps SetForUserAsync/SetForGroupAsync).

cicd.name: gitlab_list_my_pipelines
cicd.purpose: List pipelines the authenticated token's user triggered, across every project they can see.

cicd.name: gitlab_list_jobs
cicd.purpose: List a project's jobs across pipelines, filterable by status/scope and ref.

cicd.name: gitlab_list_pipeline_schedule_pipelines
cicd.purpose: List the pipelines a given schedule has triggered, to confirm it is actually firing.

cicd.name: gitlab_list_ci_variables
cicd.purpose: List the CI/CD variables defined on a project or group (scope parameter selects ListGroupVariablesAsync); values are already GitLab-redacted where masked.

cicd.name: gitlab_list_job_artifacts
cicd.purpose: List the files inside a job's artifacts archive to find the exact path to fetch.

cicd.name: gitlab_list_triggers
cicd.purpose: List the pipeline trigger tokens configured on a project.

cicd.name: gitlab_list_job_token_allowlist
cicd.purpose: List the projects or groups allowed to authenticate against this project using its CI job token (kind parameter selects ListGroupsAllowlistAsync).

cicd.name: gitlab_validate_ci_config
cicd.purpose: Lint a .gitlab-ci.yml — either content you supply or, when omitted, what's already committed via ValidateProjectConfigurationAsync — returning validity, errors and the merged/expanded YAML. Never throws for invalid YAML; check the Valid field.

cicd.name: gitlab_list_pipeline_bridge_jobs
cicd.purpose: List the bridge jobs that start downstream pipelines from this one, to trace multi-project pipeline chains.

cicd.name: gitlab_list_pipeline_jobs
cicd.purpose: List the jobs that belong to one pipeline, to see per-stage pass/fail status.

cicd.name: gitlab_create_pipeline_schedule
cicd.purpose: Create a new cron-triggered pipeline schedule for a ref.

cicd.name: gitlab_create_ci_variable
cicd.purpose: Create a new CI/CD variable on a project or group (also covers CreateGroupVariableAsync).

cicd.name: gitlab_create_pipeline
cicd.purpose: Trigger a new pipeline run for a branch, tag or commit ref.

cicd.name: gitlab_cancel_job
cicd.purpose: Cancel a running or pending job.

cicd.name: gitlab_create_trigger
cicd.purpose: Create a new pipeline trigger token; its value is only ever shown in full at creation.

cicd.name: gitlab_delete_all_project_artifacts
cicd.purpose: Delete the artifacts of every job in a project (Maintainer+ role); GitLab processes the deletion in the background.

packages.name: gitlab_list_group_packages
packages.purpose: Same cross-format browse as gitlab_list_packages but across every project in a group, e.g. an org-wide 'what have we published' sweep.

packages.name: gitlab_list_container_repositories
packages.purpose: List a project's container image repositories, optionally with tag counts and total size, to see what images the project publishes.

packages.name: gitlab_list_debian_distributions
packages.purpose: List a project's Debian (APT) repository distributions/codenames, e.g. to see which suites (stable, bullseye-security) are configured.

packages.name: gitlab_list_terraform_module_versions
packages.purpose: List every published version of a Terraform module with its dependency metadata, e.g. to decide which version a consumer should pin to.

packages.name: gitlab_list_package_protection_rules
packages.purpose: List a project's package protection rules — which package name patterns, by format, only Maintainer+ (or Owner+ for delete) may push or delete.

packages.name: gitlab_list_container_registry_protection_rules
packages.purpose: List a project's container repository protection rules — which image repository path patterns only Maintainer+/Owner+ may push to or delete from.

packages.name: gitlab_delete_package
packages.purpose: Remove a package and every file it owns from the registry, regardless of format — e.g. purging a bad or leaked release.

packages.name: gitlab_delete_container_repository
packages.purpose: Delete an entire container repository and every image tag it holds — decommissioning an image entirely.

packages.name: gitlab_create_package_protection_rule
packages.purpose: Lock down a package name pattern (e.g. 'release-*' for npm) so only roles at or above a chosen level can push or delete matching packages.

packages.name: gitlab_create_container_registry_protection_rule
packages.purpose: Protect a container repository path pattern so only roles at or above a chosen level can push images to or delete images from repositories matching it.

search.name: gitlab_list_search_migrations
search.purpose: List every advanced-search (Elasticsearch) migration known to the instance, for diagnosing search-index health. Admin token required.

search.name: gitlab_list_all_snippets
search.purpose: List every snippet on the instance, personal and project alike. Requires Administrator or Auditor access.

search.name: gitlab_list_license_templates
search.purpose: List available open-source license templates with metadata (key, name, popular flag); set popular-only to get the short common list.

search.name: gitlab_list_code_review_analytics
search.purpose: Stream code-review metrics (review time, approver, diff stats) for a project's open merge requests, bounded by limit — for spotting stalled or slow-reviewed MRs.

search.name: gitlab_list_wiki_pages
search.purpose: List a project's or group's wiki pages (title/slug/format), optionally with content included; picks ListForGroupAsync when a group is given instead of a project.

search.name: gitlab_list_code_search_indexed_namespaces
search.purpose: List every namespace indexed on one Zoekt exact-code-search node.

search.name: gitlab_list_knowledge_graph_namespaces
search.purpose: List every namespace with GitLab Duo Knowledge Graph enabled on this instance.

search.name: gitlab_update_active_context_collection
search.purpose: Adjust an ActiveContext collection's queue-sharding options (shard count/limit) for scaling its indexing throughput.

search.name: gitlab_create_wiki_page
search.purpose: Create a new wiki page (title + markdown content) in a project's or group's wiki.

search.name: gitlab_add_code_search_indexed_namespace
search.purpose: Add a namespace to a Zoekt node's exact-code-search index.

search.name: gitlab_create_snippet
search.purpose: Create a personal snippet, or a project snippet (CreateForProjectAsync, Visibility required there) when a project is given.

search.name: gitlab_disable_knowledge_graph_namespace
search.purpose: Disable GitLab Duo Knowledge Graph for a namespace, removing its graph indexing.

infra.name: gitlab_list_dependencies
infra.purpose: List the dependencies (versions, package managers, known vulnerabilities/licenses) the last dependency-scanning job found in a project.

infra.name: gitlab_list_cluster_agent_tokens
infra.purpose: List an agent's active authentication tokens (metadata only, never the secret) to audit what is authorized to connect.

infra.name: gitlab_list_terraform_state_protection_rules
infra.purpose: List the write-access protection rules configured for a project's Terraform states.

infra.name: gitlab_list_error_tracking_client_keys
infra.purpose: List the client keys issued for a project's integrated error tracking, to audit what is currently allowed to report errors in.

infra.name: gitlab_download_attestation
infra.purpose: Download one attestation's raw provenance bundle by its project-scoped id, for offline signature/provenance verification.

infra.name: gitlab_create_terraform_state_protection_rule
infra.purpose: Restrict who can write a named Terraform state to a minimum access level, optionally CI-only or protected-branch-CI-only.

infra.name: gitlab_create_cluster_agent_token
infra.purpose: Issue a new authentication token for a cluster agent (max 2 active); the plaintext secret is returned exactly once for deploying to the agent.

infra.name: gitlab_create_error_tracking_client_key
infra.purpose: Issue a new client key (with an auto-generated public key/DSN) for an application to report errors into GitLab's integrated error tracking.

deploy.name: gitlab_list_group_releases
deploy.purpose: List releases across every project in a group, optionally in a simplified shape.

deploy.name: gitlab_list_admin_runners
deploy.purpose: List every runner on the instance (admin/auditor only) for fleet-wide capacity or compliance review.

deploy.name: gitlab_list_instance_pages_domains
deploy.purpose: List every Pages domain on the instance with its owning project and whether its certificate has expired (admin only).

deploy.name: gitlab_list_runner_controller_scopes
deploy.purpose: List what a controller currently governs - the whole instance (RunnerId null) or specific runners.

deploy.name: gitlab_list_deployment_merge_requests
deploy.purpose: List the merge requests GitLab associates with a deployment, to see what code shipped in it.

deploy.name: gitlab_list_admin_deploy_keys
deploy.purpose: List every deploy key on the instance, or (given a user id) every project deploy key accessible to one user; admin only. Also covers ListForUserAsync.

deploy.name: gitlab_list_admin_deploy_tokens
deploy.purpose: List every deploy token on the instance (admin only).

deploy.name: gitlab_list_secure_files
deploy.purpose: List a project's secure files (CI/CD signing certificates, provisioning profiles, etc.) by metadata only.

deploy.name: gitlab_create_runner_controller_token
deploy.purpose: Create a new token record for a controller (metadata only - rotate it afterward to obtain a usable secret).

deploy.name: gitlab_create_release
deploy.purpose: Cut a new release from a tag, with notes and linked milestones.

deploy.name: gitlab_update_runner
deploy.purpose: Change a runner's description, tags, pause state, lock or timeout without recreating it.

deploy.name: gitlab_create_environment
deploy.purpose: Register a new deployment environment on a project.

deploy.name: gitlab_create_pages_domain
deploy.purpose: Add a custom domain to a project's Pages site, with a supplied certificate or via Let's Encrypt auto-SSL.

deploy.name: gitlab_create_instance_deploy_key
deploy.purpose: Create a deploy key directly on the instance (admin only), unattached to any project until enabled there.

admin.name: gitlab_get_instance_appearance
admin.purpose: View the instance-wide sign-in/sign-up branding (logo, colors, messages).

admin.name: gitlab_list_feature_flag_user_lists
admin.purpose: List a project's feature flag user lists (bounded).

admin.name: gitlab_list_license_policies
admin.purpose: List a project's software license compliance policies (allowed/denied verdicts), bounded.

admin.name: gitlab_list_group_integrations
admin.purpose: List a group's active third-party integrations, bounded.

admin.name: gitlab_list_background_migration_operations
admin.purpose: List batched background operations on the instance (bounded) — the finer-grained unit a migration is made of.

admin.name: gitlab_list_audit_events
admin.purpose: List the instance-wide audit log, optionally filtered by entity type/id or date range (bounded). Requires administrator access.

admin.name: gitlab_list_project_hook_deliveries
admin.purpose: List a project webhook's delivery log, newest first, for debugging failed deliveries (7-day retention, bounded).

admin.name: gitlab_list_group_hook_deliveries
admin.purpose: List a group webhook's delivery log, newest first (7-day retention, bounded).

admin.name: gitlab_create_feature_flag
admin.purpose: Create a project feature flag, optionally with strategies already attached.

admin.name: gitlab_set_license_policy
admin.purpose: Create or update the allow/deny verdict for a software license on a project (upserts by license name; calls UpdateManagedAsync instead of CreateManagedAsync when the named policy already exists).

admin.name: gitlab_create_project_hook
admin.purpose: Add a webhook to a project, selecting which event types it fires on.

admin.name: gitlab_create_group_hook
admin.purpose: Add a webhook to a group, selecting which event types it fires on.

admin.name: gitlab_create_system_hook
admin.purpose: Register an instance-wide system hook that fires on events across every project and group.

admin.name: gitlab_set_group_integration
admin.purpose: Create or fully replace a group integration's settings by slug (same full-replace semantics as the project form).

lifecycle.name: gitlab_duo_chat
lifecycle.purpose: Ask GitLab Duo Chat a question, optionally scoped to an issue/MR/commit, without leaving the MCP session.

lifecycle.name: gitlab_list_project_templates
lifecycle.purpose: List the Dockerfile/.gitignore/CI/licence/issue/MR templates available to a project, bounded by limit.

lifecycle.name: gitlab_list_bulk_import_entities
lifecycle.purpose: List the per-group/per-project entities of one migration, or of every migration when no import id is given, bounded by limit.

lifecycle.name: gitlab_list_ml_experiments
lifecycle.purpose: List a project's MLflow-tracked experiments, paged/ordered, bounded by limit.

lifecycle.name: gitlab_get_group_export_download_info
lifecycle.purpose: Confirm a scheduled group export archive is ready and report its size/name without transferring the archive bytes.

lifecycle.name: gitlab_create_ml_experiment
lifecycle.purpose: Create a new MLflow-compatible experiment in a project.

lifecycle.name: gitlab_export_project
lifecycle.purpose: Schedule an async export of a project so its archive can later be downloaded or used to seed a migration.

lifecycle.name: gitlab_create_bulk_import
lifecycle.purpose: Start a direct-transfer migration of groups/projects from another GitLab instance -- GitLab's recommended migration path over file export/import.
